name: Tegula - Digital Art Clock
author: Stefan Keller
description: A clock face as a mosaic: a random Lohse square of 11 x 11 tiles in one of three color palettes, with the time as black tiles in a 4x5-tile digit font. New image every hour, on swipe up and on every start. Swipes show date and seconds, double tap bottom left for a flash light.
